notes.title: Qubicks Demo Update 0.6.0
notes.content:
The release date is approaching, so you don't have much left to wait, and so your wait is not as painful. I shall give you a brand new update of the Qubicks Demo. This one features not only bug fixes (which are still really important) but new content as well that you can explore.


New Content
Portal animation and particles on enemy spawn, so now they're not just appearing from thin air.

Massively updated tutorial.

Added tutorial to the Main Menu and Level Selection screens as well.

If you accidentally hide the "Shop" panel for the first time, it will tell you now what happened.

Added a tooltip when hovering over the "XP" counter in the Evolutions screen, telling how to earn XP.

Added bounce animation when hovering over placed towers.

Added a new tower called "AC" and it works exactly as an Air Conditioner - it makes the temperature optimal for towers in a certain range.

Added a new tower called "Barracks" with 2 new mechanics - it summons other towers, more specifically "Fighters", and it can be placed only on blocks near the path.

Added tooltips to the Laboratory panel, when hovering over environmental indicators, it tells what each of them means.

Bunkers are now protected from radiation.

The higher the pollution is, the stronger the "Cataclysm Collector" tower is now.

Added animation of floating for the submarine.

Updated the Point & Click system to look for the nearest possible place position in a small range around the original click, making it much easier to hit the available spot for the tower without frustration.

Updated the Drag & Drop system to drag the tower above the unavailable territories as well - when the tower is above one of them, it becomes red.

Blockades and Fighters can now be placed anywhere on the road, even if there is a red zone from a nearby tower.


Balance Updates
Nanobots now gain XP faster.

Intensive Smoke now returns enemies on 8 blocks behind instead of the whole way.

Changed way of earning XP for fighters and blockades - they earn XP now for taking damage.

Increased cost of all submarines and increased red zone around them.

Added more health and damage to blockades and fighters.

The game is saved now only after beating each wave to prevent abuse with currency.


Fixes
Bug when smoke towers didn't actually slow down enemies.

Bug when towers could sometimes be placed on the path and in the air.

Bug when you could place towers on enemies.

Bug when left list of articles in Guidebook could be moved horizontally.

DMG numbers on towers dealing continuous damage now show DPS instead of actual damage dealt every frame.

Bug when some towers were missing from the Evolutions screen.

Bug when lightning didn't deal damage to enemies.

Bug when the submerged submarine didn't inflict the promised effects.

Bug when towers targeted enemies in the wrong order.

Responsivity issues in the tutorial on different screen resolutions.

Bug when the ground was still shaking even after selling the earthquake tower.

Bug when in tutorial, the "Tower Info Panel" was sometimes hidden.

The fighter tower was levitating when placed on the red zone of another tower.

Updated descriptions of some towers to be more understandable and relevant.

Bug when muzzle animation wasn't displayed in the machine gun mounted on a heavy tank tower.

Bug when the earthquake tower would stop after evolution.

Bug when the HP of the base wasn't saved.

Bug when the sequence of enemies wasn't saved.

Bug when you couldn't place a tower on spots where you should be able to place it.

Bug when some towers didn't earn any XP.

Bug with an enormous trench red zone.

Bug when the red zones of a collector didn't block other towers.

Bug with missing textures of the range and red zones of some towers.

Changed "Cataclysm" to "Pollution" everywhere where it was missed ("Cataclysm Collector" name remains untouched).

Other quality of life improvements.

notes.title: Qubicks Update 0.5.5
notes.content:
Working on a huge patch now, but decided that pushing a few smaller updates alongside development is better than dropping one huge update after a few months, so you can enjoy Qubicks Demo 0.5.5 now that brings a lot...


New Content
Added animated arrows showing the direction of enemies at the beginning of the round.

Added new Drag&Drop placement system, alongside the existing Point&Click one.

Added new 5x speed mode.

Added a cross (X) icon to the tower cards that can't be purchased.

Added Preferences screen that will pop up for new players, containing a quick setup wizard for better personalization of the gameplay.

Replaced "Evolutions" header in the Evolutions screen with the name of the selected evolution.

Added a new tower called Fusion Core that is deeply integrated into the radiation system.

Added Damage Numbers when receiving damage on the base.

Added animation for adding up money.

Changed the design of the open/close shop button to a gradient.


Fixes
Bug when XP wasn't added to some towers.

Bug with inconsistent size of tooltips.

Bug when clicked on the locked evolution in the Tower Info Panel, it opened the evolutions of the Soldier instead of the relevant tower.

Other minor enhancements.

notes.title: Qubicks Demo 0.5.0 Update Released [Patch Notes]
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that after a long months of work, which you probably didn't see because of the lack of updates, for what I'm really sorry, I'm finally rolling out huge update that fix most if not all the bugs you guys reported, for what I'm really thankful, so I hope you'll enjoy this new update that made Qubicks feel like a completely new game.
There are actually so many updates that I decided to split these Patch Notes into categories.


Quality of Life improvements

 Completely reworked design of Research Panel (the panel that pops up when you click on the base), now it better suits the overall style of the game, and it now shows the Health of your base.
 Completely reworked how environmental conditions work and affect gameplay - more details in the separate category below.
 Completely reworked system of level generation, now all levels are of adequate size, meaning you can find use for the whole map, not only the 1 half. Also speed of generation was increased 10 times.
 Completely reworked way of displaying ranges of the tower, now they are more optimized, don't get stuck in textures, and display dead zones of a tower.
 Made some models (e.x, cannons, laser beamers, etc.) a bit smaller so they don't poke out much to the enemy path, making it a bit more visually appealing.
 Completely reworked the design of tooltips, now they fit the visual theme and atmosphere.
 Made warnings about the environment a bit less annoying.



Environment rework

 Radioactivity now has 3 stages - the first stage makes your towers stall randomly, the second one weakens all your towers, and the third one destroys organic towers.
 Introduced "Research Points" system. Now, all research is bought for the Research Points instead of credits. Research points you can earn from multiple sources: buying them for credits, surviving waves with low levels of cataclysm, and defeating bosses.
 Cataclysm indicator in Research Panel now shows individual levels and is split into 3 stages - at the first stage, you earn 2 Research Points per wave, at the second stage, only 1 per wave, at the third stage, none.
 Added 2 new research upgrades for upgrading temperature-changing towers.
 Added a new tower called "Reflector" used to protect a small range of other towers from the effects of radiation. But this tower has a hidden cost...
 Completely reworked research upgrades. Now, to protect yourself from radiation, you will have to pay a subscription to your researchers in the form of Research Points, or take a risk that might resolve all your problems or create a new one. For cataclysm, I added a lot of new research split into 2 paths - either you want to completely get rid of it or you want to learn using it as a tool.
 [WIP] I'm working on another tower right now, with a huge amount of damage that it can increase even more using radiation, but of course, there will be downsides... More details later.
 [WIP] I'm gradually changing the "Cataclysm" system to the "Pollution" system. More details later.



"Stats for Nerds" addition

 Added new type of tooltip for displaying tower stats - now, apart from name and description, the tooltip also shows damage, fire rate, range of a tower, and other important stats, while visually still fitting the atmosphere.
 Added display of actual damage, fire rate, and range of a selected tower in Tower Info Panel (that panel that pops up when you click on a placed tower).
 Added visualization of changes to damage, fire rate, and range of a tower when hovering over an upgrade or evolution.
 Added icons to the tower cards in the shop representing where you can place that tower.
 Added info on where you can place the selected tower to the Evolutions screen.
 [WIP] Gradually adding to all descriptions the actual change to the tower after evolution, instead of abstract brief descriptions.



Smooth Immersion ensurement

 Made tutorial "skipable" so you now don't need to read it all if you don't want to (but it's still recommended).
 Added "hint" buttons to some places that might be difficult to understand for new players, which will bring them to the relevant article in the guidebook.
 Added new articles and expanded existing ones in the guidebook (Which can be found in the pause menu).
 Added new pop-up panel to the tutorial explaining the abilities of some enemies.
 Added "Open Research Panel" button to the warning messages about environment conditions.



First Glance polishing

 Added flying spaceship to the background of main menu (Which is actually pretty fun to watch, you should definitely spend your whole day watching it).
 Added titles to the main menu buttons so you can understand where each of them leads, with the option to disable them if you don't like them.
 Added Qubicks logo to the main menu with adjusted style for minimalism.
 Made sandstorm particles in the main menu heavier and slower, which helped add more depth to the main menu design.



Fixed Bugs

 Fixed bug in the level selector screen where planets didn't change their names after switching them.
 Fixed bug with incorrectly displayed text in some places.
 Fixed incorrect/inconsistent localizations in some places.
 Fixed bug when a submarine wasn't destroyed after the water below it was evaporated.
 Fixed incorrect/inconsistent colliders of towers.
 Fixed bug with infinite cycle when it was raining and the temperature was at max (Which made water evaporate and fill in again constantly).
 Increased audio limit, which should fix the issue with sounds fading away at high game speeds.
 Fixed bug when sandstorm didn't destroy some types of towers.
 Fixed all related bugs to the explosive bullets - made them actually reach their target every time at full explosion range.
 Fixed visual bug when cannon shot its first round before rotating to the enemy.
 Fixed bug when you had opened the Tower Details panel, and if you selected a tower to place, the Tower Details panel would block the placement buttons.
 Fixed bug when resurrected enemies weren't targeted properly.
 Fixed visual bug when barricades didn't rotate to the right angle right from the start.
 Fixed bug with flying submarines.
 Fixed bug when you are placing a tower and try to move the camera position, the tower is moved to the position of the cursor.
 Made the camera rotation to rotate around the cursor point, not around the center of the level.
 Fixed bug when, in some cases, arrows from the guidebook disappeared.
 Other minor improvements.

notes.title: Qubicks Demo 0.3.1 [Patch Notes]
notes.content:
[Fixed]

 Bug allowing single-use towers to be placed multiple times.
 Upgrade titles were displayed in the Evolution window instead of Evolution titles.
 Smoke Generator tower upgrades were not functioning properly.
 Various minor bugs.

notes.title: Qubicks Demo 0.3.0 [Patch Notes]
notes.content:
[Added]

 The guidebook, containing more gameplay information, is now accessible in the Help section of the pause menu.
 Updated explosion effect.
 Bullet effects have been added to shooting towers.
 Added Damage Numbers displaying damage dealt to enemies.
 Added an option to disable Damage Numbers in the settings.
 Tooltips now appear when hovering over a button instead of holding it.
 More keybinds have been added to improve accessibility and comfort. Keybinds can be viewed in the guidebook.
 Displayed the no-build range for towers, with buttons to disable this feature. These buttons are located near the message indicating where towers can be placed during placement mode.
 Improved some animations for a smoother gaming experience.


[Fixed]

 Fixed UI layout issues on different aspect ratios.
 Fixed a bug causing difficulties when clicking some buttons after introducing tooltips.
 Fixed a bug preventing Tower Info from opening when another tower’s info was already open.
 Fixed a bug where tower positioning couldn't be precisely adjusted during placement.
 Fixed an issue where the Water Base tower’s range circle appeared underground.
 Fixed an occasional bug with incorrect wave adjustments.
 Fixed various minor bugs.
